name: TeamSpeak 3 Server
description: The classic low-latency voice server. Official tarball downloaded from files.teamspeak-services.com (version-pinned).

variables.label: TeamSpeak 3 server version
variables.description: Exact version used in the download URL. Re-run install after changing it.

variables.label: Accept the TeamSpeak license
variables.description: You must accept the TeamSpeak 3 server license (LICENSE file in the server directory) to run the server.

notes: IMPORTANT: on the FIRST start the console prints the serveradmin ServerQuery password and a one-time admin privilege key — copy both from the console before they scroll away. All state lives in ts3server.sqlitedb in the server directory. Do not expose the ServerQuery port publicly without query_ip_allowlist tuning. This blueprint covers the classic TS3 server; the new TeamSpeak (6) server is a separate product.
